title: Add native authoring readiness rail to proposal workspace
summary: Move HumbleStudio a small step from passive read-only inspection toward a modern proposal-first authoring workspace by surfacing the current authoring mode, readiness gates, and blocked future edit path directly in the native proposal workspace.
acceptance_criteria: The native proposal workspace shows a compact authoring readiness rail that distinguishes inspection, proposal capture, validation, and future apply/edit states.
The rail is truthful: current repo behavior remains read-only and does not claim source mutation, Board editing, or command execution is available.
The rail connects future editing to the existing proposal-first contract and blocked Board/command tickets instead of creating a parallel write-back story.
The change-marking contract records the new native readiness surface as part of the read-only-to-authoring bridge.
Patch hygiene, ticket validation, workflow checks, and a targeted macOS build pass for the slice.

evidence.note: The contract now records the native authoring-readiness rail as the read-only-to-authoring bridge.
Real editing remains owned by command-based selection and editing after Board foundation tickets are solved.
String catalog JSON stayed valid after adding authoring-readiness copy.
No legacy L10n helper usage was introduced.
No legacy .strings or .stringsdict localization files were introduced.
Patch whitespace hygiene passed after the native readiness rail and docs update.
The HS-0090 ticket schema validated successfully.
Repo contract validation passed after the authoring-readiness slice.
Static web fallback integrity stayed green; this slice only changed native and contract surfaces.
Workflow-only local checks passed with 88 valid tickets.
The native macOS build passed after adding the readiness model and rail UI.
The repo-documented native CI path completed a build-only macOS sanity pass for HS-0090.
Strict doctor remains a branch-freshness gate and, after the commit, reported the expected topic-branch state with 0 dirty paths instead of a product failure.

trigger.source_ref: Jan asked to gradually improve HumbleStudio toward a modern HumbleControl-like world and prepare the interface for eventual edits, not only read-only inspection.

agent_notes: Keep this as a bridge surface only: no source rewrite, no design.json mutation, no BoardCommand execution.
Use the readiness rail to make the future edit path discoverable while preserving today's read-only proposal contract.
Treat HS-0043, HS-0044, and HS-0045 as the authoritative unlock path for actual editing.
